description: Client-side script for Sales Order doctype in ERPNext, handling form setup, button actions, and related operations.

classes.name: SalesOrderController
classes.description: Controller class extending SellingController, managing sales order specific actions like creating documents, updating status, and handling buttons.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initial setup when the sales order form loads, including setting default date and queries.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, adds custom buttons based on document status and permissions.

methods.name: create_pick_list
methods.description: Creates a pick list document from the sales order.

methods.name: make_work_order
methods.description: Initiates creation of work orders based on sales order items with BOM.

methods.name: order_type
methods.description: Handles order type specific logic, toggling delivery date requirements.

methods.name: tc_name
methods.description: Fetches terms and conditions.

methods.name: make_material_request
methods.description: Creates a material request from the sales order.

methods.name: skip_delivery_note
methods.description: Toggles delivery date requirement based on skip delivery note setting.

methods.name: toggle_delivery_date
methods.description: Enables or disables delivery date requirement in items grid.

methods.name: make_raw_material_request
methods.description: Initiates raw material request process.

methods.name: make_raw_material_request_dialog
methods.description: Displays dialog to select BOM and warehouse for raw material request.

methods.name: make_delivery_note_based_on_delivery_date
methods.description: Creates delivery note based on selected delivery dates.

methods.name: make_delivery_note
methods.description: Creates a delivery note document.

methods.name: make_sales_invoice
methods.description: Creates a sales invoice from the sales order.

methods.name: make_maintenance_schedule
methods.description: Creates a maintenance schedule.

methods.name: make_project
methods.description: Creates a project related to the sales order.

methods.name: make_inter_company_order
methods.description: Creates an inter-company purchase order.

methods.name: make_maintenance_visit
methods.description: Creates a maintenance visit.

methods.name: make_purchase_order
methods.description: Creates a purchase order for pending items, with options for default supplier.

methods.name: hold_sales_order
methods.description: Marks the sales order as on hold with a reason.

methods.name: close_sales_order
methods.description: Closes the sales order.

methods.name: update_status
methods.description: Updates the status of the sales order via server call.
